title: Maoko Akatukwa
intro: Unomira munzira dzakatenderedza dzeMakkah yekare, uko mweya wesimba nepfuma wakambosiya kudanwa kwechokwadi. Nyaya yemunhu uyu inoyeuchidza zvakasimba kuti zvisungo zveropa hazvigone kukunda cheni dzekuzvikudza. Ndiani uyu ane zita rinonzwika semoto uri kumirira?
clues: Ndakafamba mumigwagwa yeMakkah nekudada kwakandipofumadza kuti ndisaone chokwadi, kunyange zvazvo mutumwa wacho aive weropa rangu.
Zvinhu zvangu zvaive zvakawanda, asi zvakava chinhu chinotukwa kwete nhoo.
Bhuku renhungamiro rinotaura nezvekuparadzwa kwangu, richizivisa kuti maoko angu nehunhu hwangu zvichaparara.
Mudzimai wangu akabatana nechikwata changu cheruvengo, achiunganidza minzwa kuti iparadzirwe munzira yeuyo aidaidza kuna Allah.
Pazuva rekutongwa, ndichapinzwa mumoto wemoto unopfuta, uye mudiwa wangu achave netambo yeshinda yemuchindwe yakakomberedza mutsipa.
Ndinozivikanwa nezita rinoreva kuti 'baba vemurazvo' — zita rinofanotaura hugaro hwangu husingaperi.
